card.architecture: DreamOmni2 — FLUX.1-Kontext base (int8 via optimum-quanto + model-cpu-offload) + a Qwen2.5-VL VLM that rewrites the instruction, run through the HM-RunningHub ComfyUI pipeline nodes (no llama.cpp). Reference-based editing.
card.summary: Reference-based instruction editor: give a source image + ONE reference image and an instruction (e.g. put the object from the reference into the source). Self-contained pipeline; weights stream from RAM (int8 DiT ~12GB + VLM on CPU). Slower per run due to offload.
use_cases: reference-based editing (insert/transfer an element from a reference into the source)
identity/style transfer guided by a reference image
card.pick_when: You have a reference image and want its content/style brought into the source image.

prompt.guidance: Provide the source image + ONE reference image + an instruction referring to the reference.
prompt.example: Add the hat from the reference image onto the person
prompt.overview: Reference-based edit. Attach exactly one reference image; the VLM rewrites your instruction and the Kontext base applies it. If no reference is attached, the source is used as its own reference.

negative.note: No negative input; the pipeline runs at guidance 3.5.

speed.note: int8 Kontext + CPU-offloaded VLM; per-run VLM↔GPU shuffle. Needs ample system RAM.

ui_help.note: Reference-based edit — attach one reference image the instruction refers to.
ui_help.good_for: bringing content/style from a reference image into the source

edit_use_cases: reference-based instruction editing: transfer an element/style from a reference image into the source

reference.hint: Attach ONE reference image; your instruction should refer to it (e.g. 'use the jacket from the reference').
